routes.description: Convert a Word document into a fixed-layout PDF with diagnostics.
routes.supportEvidence: Realistic DOCX fixtures cover paragraphs, lists, tables, drawings, pagination, tagged output, portable fonts, and deterministic conversion reports.
routes.knownLimitations: Complex floating layout, advanced DrawingML, SmartArt, field behavior, and exact Microsoft Word pagination are not fully reproduced.

routes.description: Render workbook sheets with layout and conversion diagnostics.
routes.supportEvidence: Structured workbook fixtures cover tables, values, formulas, styles, print layout, pagination, tagged output, and deterministic diagnostics.
routes.knownLimitations: Pivot tables, advanced conditional formatting, charts, external links, and exact Excel print-layout behavior remain incomplete.

routes.description: Render presentation slides into a fixed-layout PDF.
routes.supportEvidence: Slide fixtures cover text, tables, basic shapes, images, charts, themes, page geometry, tagged output, and deterministic diagnostics.
routes.knownLimitations: SmartArt, animation, media playback, advanced effects, uncommon DrawingML, and exact PowerPoint composition remain incomplete.

routes.description: Render bounded HTML and CSS into a tagged PDF.
routes.supportEvidence: Representative HTML documents cover headings, lists, tables, links, images, pagination, tagged output, portable fonts, and conversion reports.
routes.knownLimitations: The renderer supports bounded HTML and CSS, not a full browser layout engine; scripts, dynamic layout, and advanced CSS are intentionally unsupported.

routes.description: Render typed Markdown through an explicit safe HTML profile.
routes.supportEvidence: Typed Markdown fixtures cover common block and inline constructs, safe profiles, deterministic HTML, and explicit diagnostics.
routes.knownLimitations: Raw HTML, extension-specific syntax, and browser-dependent styling are governed by the selected safety and rendering profile.

routes.description: Project HTML into portable Markdown with explicit resource and loss policy.
routes.supportEvidence: Representative HTML fixtures cover portable text structure, lists, tables, links, resources, and deterministic loss reporting.
routes.knownLimitations: CSS layout, scripting, arbitrary embedded content, and presentation-only markup are simplified or omitted.

routes.description: Create an editable Word document from typed Markdown.
routes.supportEvidence: Representative Markdown fixtures reopen as editable DOCX and verify headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, links, and images with diagnostics.
routes.knownLimitations: Raw HTML, extension-specific syntax, and constructs without a Word equivalent may be simplified.

routes.description: Project a Word document into reviewable HTML.
routes.supportEvidence: Representative Word fixtures verify readable structure, tables, lists, links, images, and deterministic semantic output.
routes.knownLimitations: Page layout, floating objects, advanced fields, tracked changes, and unsupported DrawingML are simplified in semantic output.

routes.description: Convert a Word document into portable Markdown for editing, publishing, or version control.
routes.supportEvidence: Representative Word fixtures verify readable structure, tables, lists, links, images, and deterministic semantic output.
routes.knownLimitations: Page layout, floating objects, advanced fields, tracked changes, and unsupported DrawingML are simplified in semantic output.

routes.description: Convert editable Word content to OpenDocument Text.
routes.supportEvidence: Reopen tests verify common paragraphs, runs, lists, tables, links, and basic images with explicit approximation diagnostics.
routes.knownLimitations: Fields, notes, section-specific layout, advanced drawings, nested styles, and producer-specific extensions remain incomplete.

routes.description: Convert OpenDocument Text into an editable Word document.
routes.supportEvidence: Reopen tests verify common paragraphs, runs, lists, tables, links, and basic images with explicit approximation diagnostics.
routes.knownLimitations: Fields, notes, section-specific layout, advanced drawings, nested styles, and producer-specific extensions remain incomplete.

routes.description: Import PDF logical content into an editable Word document with diagnostics.
routes.supportEvidence: Reopen tests verify parser-supported text, headings, lists, and detected tables in an editable Word document with loss diagnostics.
routes.knownLimitations: This is semantic reconstruction, not page-layout recovery; scans need OCR and complex graphics, columns, clipping, annotations, and exact pagination are not preserved.

routes.description: Import detected PDF tables into an editable workbook with diagnostics.
routes.supportEvidence: Reopen tests verify detected PDF tables as editable worksheet cells with source-page evidence and loss diagnostics.
routes.knownLimitations: Only table-shaped content is in scope; arbitrary page layout, charts, free text, scans without OCR, and workbook formulas are not reconstructed.

routes.description: Reconstruct supported PDF content as native slide objects, or select explicit visual, hybrid, and tables-only projections with diagnostics.
routes.supportEvidence: Reopen tests verify explicit editable, tables-only, hybrid, and visual page modes with native objects, pixel-pinned visual fallback, and loss reports.
routes.knownLimitations: Editable reconstruction is bounded to supported text, tables, basic shapes, and images; complex graphics, clipping, reading order, and effects remain incomplete.

routes.description: Project PDF content into semantic or positioned-review HTML with explicit diagnostics.
routes.supportEvidence: Semantic and positioned-review profiles verify readable text, detected tables, page geometry hints, images, links, forms, and deterministic diagnostics.
routes.knownLimitations: The result is review HTML, not a full PDF renderer; complex graphics, optional content, scans without OCR, and pixel-perfect composition are not preserved.

routes.description: Render every PDF page as a detailed PNG with page-level diagnostics; multi-page results are packaged as a ZIP.
routes.supportEvidence: Pixel-pinned page-render tests cover text, drawings, tables, images, portable fonts, and deterministic multi-page packaging.
routes.knownLimitations: Type 3 glyph programs, advanced color profiles, patterns, masks, transparency groups, optional content, and scanned-text OCR remain incomplete.

routes.description: Import PDF logical content into semantic RTF with diagnostics.
routes.supportEvidence: Reopen tests verify parser-supported logical text and basic structure in an editable text-document destination with loss diagnostics.
routes.knownLimitations: Page layout, complex graphics, columns, clipping, annotations, scans without OCR, and exact pagination are not reconstructed.

routes.description: Import PDF logical content into OpenDocument Text with diagnostics.
routes.supportEvidence: Reopen tests verify parser-supported logical text and basic structure in an editable text-document destination with loss diagnostics.
routes.knownLimitations: Page layout, complex graphics, columns, clipping, annotations, scans without OCR, and exact pagination are not reconstructed.

routes.description: Import PDF pages into an OpenDocument presentation profile with diagnostics.

routes.knownLimitations: Complex graphics, clipping, reading order, effects, annotations, and exact visual reconstruction remain incomplete.

routes.supportEvidence: Bounded archive fixtures verify MIME resource resolution, safe HTML projection, PDF output, and deterministic diagnostics.
routes.knownLimitations: Scripts, remote execution, browser-only layout, malformed multipart edge cases, and advanced CSS are not a full browser/MHTML engine.

routes.description: Render a Visio drawing into a fixed-layout PDF.
routes.supportEvidence: Typed drawing fixtures verify supported pages, shapes, connectors, text, geometry, and fixed-layout diagnostics.
routes.knownLimitations: Advanced masters, data graphics, themes, layers, embedded objects, and exact Visio rendering remain incomplete.
